text.text_excerpt: I am an olive oil and balsamic vinegar lover, and the varieties here are plenty, and are of excellent quality. I've made a few purchases from Verdure in the past few months and am more than pleased with the products. Their traditional balsamic vinegar is my favorite, but the other varieties - fig, for instance - are amazing as well. The traditional balsamic is rich and sweet. It's perfect for salads and for use in your favorite marinades. Their olive oils are also varied. I'm a sucker for a robust OO, and they carry several. I learned today that there is a 10% discount if you bring in your clean, empty bottles from previous Verdure purchases. I can definitely do that. Also, they carry lot...

Love this place! They have tons of selection and whomever is working is always knowledgeable and can help guide you. We go there to buy aged balsamic which is amazing. We have also gotten a few olive oils and a white balsamic in the past which were very good. We will continue to be loyal customers :)

This place is AMAZING! Just when I didn't need anywhere else to spend my money, we stumbled upon this place. They have a ton of olive oil and balsamic vinegars and bread for you to try it on! We decided on the lemon olive oil. It is simply amazing. They also have a ton of pasta, tomato sauce, beer bread etc. The man that was working (didn't catch his name) was super nice! He also mentioned you get 10% off if you bring back the bottle clean for a refill. A super plus was his adorable daughter was selling Girl Scout cookies!!! My boyfriend and I have decided that we will definitely be back AT LEAST once a month (probably more haha). Definitely worth it go check it out!!
